objective: saves_per_reach: Create a seven-day Deepavali campaign for Poojaloka's diyas, brass items and pooja essentials across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and Threads, aimed at families in Bengaluru.
audience: Families in Bengaluru and across Karnataka preparing for daily pooja and festivals; people setting up a first home altar. (Suggested from the catalogue and site; confirm with real customer data.)
headline: Clay for your pooja space
tagline: Our Matki Diya, from the Mud Items range at Poojaloka
required_text: Our Matki Diya, from the Mud Items range at Poojaloka

purity, origin, authenticity, health or spiritual-benefit claims
deity imagery, religious figures, mantras or Sanskrit text

competitor names, text, layouts or imagery

canva_query: Design a 1080×1350 (4:5 portrait) Instagram post for Poojaloka. Layout: solid colour band at the top holding the headline, tagline below. Colours #2B1810, #D9722A, #6B1420; mood: warm, respectful and uncluttered. Text, exactly as written: "Clay for your pooja space", "Our Matki Diya, from the Mud Items range at Poojaloka", "Tap the link in bio", "Poojaloka". Use exactly the quoted text and add no other words, numbers, prices, offers or claims. Typographic only: no product photos, stock photos, deities, religious figures, mantras or Sanskrit text.
